results.title: Mastodon rises from turmoil with defiant new album
results.description: Between the acrimonious split and subsequent death of a key band member and the passing of another's mother, heavy rock troupe Mastodon has thundered back with new lineup and a hot new album. "Marrow Deep." The Grammy Award-nominated group, feeling "rejuvenated," stomps into town Tuesday, Oct. 20 at the Agora.

results.title: Shirley Ballas speaks out after Strictly Come Dancing fans' confusion over epic moves at 66
Nikam backs Prahaar casting; lawyer says he was won over on set
results.description: Ujjwal Nikam, who knew nothing of Rajkummar Rao before “Prahaar,” says he asked, “Who is this Rajkummar?” when told Rao would play him. After meeting the actor on set, he called him “a real actor.” The film releases October 16, and Rao’s next biopic is “Dada.”
